description: Coordinate local git and GitHub objects without expanding read or preparation authority into remote mutations.
requiredOutcomes: Owner, repository, remote, branch, base, and issue or pull request target are aligned before mutation.
Issues and pull requests contain behavior, scope, risk, verification, compatibility, and rollback evidence as relevant.
Review and CI work uses thread or log evidence available from the actual provider.
Commit, push, PR creation, review resolution, merge, tag, and release are treated as separate authorities.
forbiddenOutcomes: A read-only request changes issue, pull request, label, review, or repository state.
Commit or push authority is expanded into merge, close, tag, or release authority.
CI root cause is claimed from check metadata when logs were unavailable.
Shared history, protection, tags, or branches are changed destructively without explicit authority.
